decisions.reason: The request for a revised BOM does not change the independently requested system-layout deliverable.
The source requests revision of the BOM but does not change the wiring-plan deliverable or its contents.
A revised BOM may document selected components, but the source does not alter any dispensing-flow or froth-preservation requirement.
The request for a revised BOM does not replace or modify the confirmed 120V wall-powered architecture.
The source contains no change to enclosure size, side profile, or bowl-well form.
Requiring a BOM revision does not change the prototype's reliability requirement for event use.
The source requests a revised component document but does not change the off-the-shelf component strategy or the confirmed custom-spout exception.
The source does not change the stainless-steel spout material or any other food-contact material requirement.
The request for a revised BOM does not specify a different bowl capacity, form, or size preference.
The source does not alter the quick, preferably tool-free whisk-removal behavior; the nearby whisk discussion is separate from the BOM revision request.
The source does not change the stable, vibration-resistant base requirement.
